name: Memory Seal
tagline: The integrity primitive for agent memory
description: Two primitives, both real, both client-side: a 12-rule contamination scanner (injected directives, secrets, contradictions, staleness) and Ed25519-sealed tamper-evident checkpoints that catch any add/remove/edit/reorder since sealing.
for_agents: Free to use. Cite facts with their provenance labels. Heuristic triage, not proof. A clean scan is not proof of clean memory. A checkpoint proves integrity since sealing, not truth.
